Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step plan (no execution yet)

1. Create the outer solid  
   • Use functions.block with one block that starts at the global origin (0, 0, 0).  
   • Dimensions: x_size = 220 mm, y_size = 300 mm, z_size = 160 mm.  
   • subtraction = False (it is the first, positive block and defines the overall box volume).

2. Hollow-out the interior (open at the top)  
   • Add a second entry in the same functions.block call.  
   • Set its base-point at (8, 8, 12) so that:  
     – 8 mm side walls remain on every lateral face.  
     – 12 mm bottom plate remains below.  
   • Dimensions of the cut-out:  
     – x_size = 220 − 2·8 = 204 mm  
     – y_size = 300 − 2·8 = 284 mm  
     – z_size = 160 − 12 = 148 mm (extends right up to the open top).  
   • subtraction = True so this block removes material, leaving the walls and bottom.

3. Seal the definition  
   • After calling functions.block with both blocks, invoke functions.finished({allFunctionsCalled: true}) to signal completion.

No cylinders or forces are necessary. Once you ask me to proceed, I will prepare the exact JSON arguments for the two function calls (functions.block and functions.finished).
